facts.fact: The Minister of the Interior and Decentralisation told the Senate on 7 August 2026 that the government's answer to the trafficking of civil status acts includes their digitalisation through the project of a Système intégré de gestion de l'état civil, which he said will strengthen control over the making, archiving and issuing of acts.
